column1: # Default public DNS resolver database for dns-speedtest.
#   enabled  provider  ip  service_type  filtering  notes  source
# Filtering resolvers are labeled and disabled by default so they are not
# silently compared as equivalent to unfiltered resolvers.
# IPv6 rows are accepted by the parser; bundled defaults that are enabled
# are IPv4 for predictable out-of-the-box operation.
# Addresses verified against official provider documentation on 2026-08-16.
# Three product categories: unfiltered (1.1.1.1), malware (1.1.1.2), family (1.1.1.3).
# IPv4 secondaries are enabled. IPv6 stays disabled for predictable IPv4-only runs.

column6: 1.1.1.1 for Families: block malware and adult content
1.1.1.1 for Families secondary: malware and adult content
